verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for a consumer communication platform like Discord, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting or policy that keeps user data out of AI model training. The pack covers developer APIs, the Social SDK, Nitro perks, and community complaints about ID verification, none of which address AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
